    Telstra Personal

    Go big or go home

    Glad we went big.
    Explore our Big Black Friday Sale.

    Ends 30 Nov.

    Shop Big Black Friday Sale
    Transcript

    Transcript

    15 second video.
    We see a Telstra shopping bag sitting on the concrete floor of a neutral grey space.
    On the bag are the words ‘Big Black Friday Sale’.
    Miniature people run out from behind the bag as ropes are tossed over the top.
    We jump cut to see a much bigger crowd of miniature characters fastening more ropes around the bag until it’s secure.
    The crowd of miniature people begin to pull the Telstra bag out of frame with a rhythmic heaving motion.
    As they pull, a miniature strongman sprints in from the side and adds his weight to the pulling, causing the bag to disappear from frame.
    A miniature girl is gleefully chased out of frame by a little dog.
